############################################################
# DESAFIO 1 - Escopo do DNS interno do Docker
############################################################
--- /etc/resolv.conf do proxy (deve apontar o DNS embutido 127.0.0.11) ---
# Generated by Docker Engine.
# This file can be edited; Docker Engine will not make further changes once it
# has been modified.

nameserver 127.0.0.11
search as3oyaxyermercpknrxo0v1cld.cx.internal.cloudapp.net
options timeout:1 attempts:5 ndots:0

# Based on host file: '/etc/resolv.conf' (internal resolver)
# ExtServers: [168.63.129.16]
# Overrides: [nameservers]
# Option ndots from: internal

--- nslookup radar-backend a partir do proxy (DEVE resolver: mesmo escopo frontend-net) ---
Server:		127.0.0.11
Address:	127.0.0.11:53

** server can't find radar-backend.as3oyaxyermercpknrxo0v1cld.cx.internal.cloudapp.net: NXDOMAIN

** server can't find radar-backend.as3oyaxyermercpknrxo0v1cld.cx.internal.cloudapp.net: NXDOMAIN


--- nslookup radar-db a partir do proxy (NAO deve resolver: banco so existe na backend-net) ---
Server:		127.0.0.11
Address:	127.0.0.11:53

** server can't find radar-db.as3oyaxyermercpknrxo0v1cld.cx.internal.cloudapp.net: NXDOMAIN

** server can't find radar-db.as3oyaxyermercpknrxo0v1cld.cx.internal.cloudapp.net: NXDOMAIN

(NXDOMAIN - esperado)

>>> NOTA: o nslookup do busybox acrescenta o 'search domain' do Codespaces ao nome;
>>> por isso a prova definitiva de ESCOPO e feita pela conexao via NOME abaixo:
--- nc -z -v -w5 radar-backend 80 (a partir do proxy: DEVE conectar) ---
radar-backend (172.20.10.20:80) open
>>> SUCESSO: proxy descobre radar-backend pelo nome (frontend-net compartilhada).
--- nc -z -v -w5 radar-db 5432 (a partir do proxy: NAO deve conectar) ---
nc: bad address 'radar-db'
>>> Esperado: proxy NAO descobre/alcanca radar-db (fora do escopo da backend-net).

    link/ether 56:4f:38:f3:5e:66 brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
    inet 172.20.20.20/24 brd 172.20.20.255 scope global eth0
       valid_lft forever preferred_lft forever
4: eth1@if11: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP,M-DOWN> mtu 1500 qdisc noqueue state UP 
    link/ether 92:9d:91:a8:03:81 brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
    inet 172.20.10.20/24 brd 172.20.10.255 scope global eth1
       valid_lft forever preferred_lft forever

--- ip route show (qual interface tem a rota default?) ---
default via 172.20.10.1 dev eth1 
172.20.10.0/24 dev eth1 scope link  src 172.20.10.20 
172.20.20.0/24 dev eth0 scope link  src 172.20.20.20 
>>> A rota default sai pela interface da frontend-net (bridge NAO internal),
>>> pois a backend-net (internal:true) nao possui gateway para fora.
